description: One transaction by the slug of its DocketTrail page (the transaction_slug of a search result): every state proceeding in it with the agency's wording and source link, the full trail of dated events (as the agency published or printed them), documents, and the changes DocketTrail observed. Covers healthcare transaction reviews (OR, CA, MA, NM), certificate-of-need projects (WA, IA, IL, FL, NC, HI, MO, GA, SC, VA, KY, DE) and nonprofit health facility notices (CA) only (see https://dockettrail.com/coverage for what is tracked and what was checked and not tracked). Every result is a public agency record, in the agency's own words, with source_url (the agency page it was read from) and the day DocketTrail observed it (observed_day, first_seen_at, last_checked_at; UTC). Nothing here is legal advice, and absence from the data is not a claim that no review exists.

slug.description: The transaction slug, the last part of https://dockettrail.com/transactions/{slug}.
